binding.note: These sheets are presentation assets for the browser prototype. They do not encode simulation state, agent identity, KEP exchange, ARE execution, or AlchLang authority.

limitations: The sheets are newly authored visual references and are not recovered source art.
The props use one front-facing perspective; collision and construction geometry remain prototype layout data.
